children: Essential Properties Realty Trust published its 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report highlighting a record $1.3 billion of 2025 gross investments and a 2,300-property, 99.7% leased portfolio.
Published 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report and attached as Exhibit 99.1 on company website.
Completed a record $1.3B of gross investments across 270 properties in 2025, highest annual level in company history.
Ended 2025 with 2,300 properties in 48 states, leased to 447 tenants and 99.7% occupancy.
Expanded ESG and risk practices: third-party catastrophe modeling on ~2,291 properties and new AI, file-sharing, and incident response policies.
Corporate operations reported Scope 2 emissions of 38.64 mtCO2e in 2025 (13.1% decrease vs. 2024); 57% of properties subject to Green Lease provisions.
